title: Legal and Administrative Evidence Submission
decision_boundary: May this media asset be accepted into the identified proceeding as an authenticated submission from an authorized actor under the recorded rules?

cases.condition: recognized actor, valid delegation, and in-scope action/resource/context
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: recognized actor but action, resource, purpose, or context is outside delegation
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: authority or delegation is revoked at the evaluated decision time
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: required authority or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement
Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: material metadata or authority evidence is corrected after the original decision
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

limitations: Acceptance into an evidence workflow is not a ruling on admissibility, authenticity in the legal sense, probative value, ownership, or the merits of a proceeding.
